# Because You Are Busy — Operations · Transformation · Growth

> Because You Are Busy (BYAB) is an operations, transformation, and growth consultancy founded in 2005. Because you are busy, we run what you can't get to anymore — externalized operations, data-powered transformation, and B2B growth engineering for founders and managing partners. 57% operating profitability, 0€ external debt, 20+ years of uninterrupted service.

## Primary Keyword

"because you are busy" — This is the brand name, core message, and the reason clients come to us.

## Pages

- [Homepage](/) — Agency landing page: services, track record, company history with backlinks, stats, about, testimonial, and contact form
- [Design](/design) — Complete design system: brand identity, design tokens, UI components, and site section reference (noindex)

## What Is Because You Are Busy?

Because You Are Busy (abbreviated BYAB) is a consultancy that serves founders and managing partners who are too busy to handle everything themselves. Founded on April 1, 2005 by Cécile Noiriel, registered under SIREN 481 631 471, Because You Are Busy has spent over 20 years proving that founders don't lack ideas — they lack time and structure to execute them. A second entity (SIREN 814 783 056) was created in November 2015 by Anne Grosz, specializing in externalized general secretariat for law firms and SMEs. As of 2026, the team is four: Cécile Noiriel, Anne Grosz, Georges Grosz, and Romain Cornu.

## Services

1. **Operational Backbone** — Because You Are Busy externalizes your entire back-office — general secretariat, admin, finance, and compliance — so founders and managing partners stop drowning in operational detail and start leading. Run by a team with 20+ years of law firm and SME operational experience.
2. **Transformation & Data** — Because You Are Busy rebuilds the systems layer — architecture, project governance, and data strategy — that transforms operational chaos into measurable clarity. Anchored in 22+ years of CGI systems consulting and academic expertise at Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne.
3. **Growth Engine** — Because You Are Busy engineers your full commercial pipeline — ICP definition, outbound sequences, acquisition funnels, and revenue metrics — so growth becomes systematic, not a function of effort or luck. Built on proven playbooks from MerciApp, Clovis, and Datananas.
4. **Legal Practice Ops** — Because You Are Busy provides purpose-built operational support for law firms where precision is non-negotiable. Born from Anne Grosz's 8 years as Secretary General at Vatier & Associés, this service handles everything partners shouldn't have to: admin, finance, compliance, and client file management.

## Who We Are

The Because You Are Busy team (as of 2026) brings four complementary forces:

- **Cécile Noiriel** ([LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/c%C3%A9cile-noiriel-18396327/)) — Founder — B Y A B, 2005. Cécile Noiriel founded Because You Are Busy (B Y A B, SIREN 481 631 471) on April 1, 2005 — with a conviction ahead of its time: founders don't lack courage, they lack time and structure. She has run the operation continuously for over 20 years, serving as the firm's founding operational anchor.
- **Anne Grosz** ([LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/annegrosz)) — Founder & Operations. Anne Grosz spent 8 years as Secretary General & CFO at Vatier & Associés (Paris law firm) before founding the second Because You Are Busy entity in 2015. She leads externalized general secretariat for law firms and SMEs — finance, admin, HR, and ISO compliance — with in-house rigor at external scale.
- **Georges Grosz** ([LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/georges-grosz-8aa9613)) — Transformation & Data. Georges Grosz brings 22+ years as Senior Executive Consultant at CGI and teaches information systems at Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne. He joined Because You Are Busy as co-manager in July 2025, adding the systems architecture discipline that turns fragmented operations into governed, decision-ready infrastructure.
- **Romain Cornu** ([LinkedIn](https://fr.linkedin.com/in/romaincornu)) — Growth Engine. Romain Cornu spent nearly 6 years at MerciApp — from Growth Advisor to GTM & Key Accounts Lead — and 4+ years as Head of Growth at Clovis, plus Head of Marketing at Datananas. At Because You Are Busy, he designs go-to-market engines that make B2B revenue growth systematic, not accidental.

## Company History

- **2005** — The founding conviction: Because You Are Busy (B Y A B, SIREN 481 631 471) created April 1, 2005 by Cécile Noiriel. Ultra-lean, ultra-profitable structure — revenue ~130,000€, 57%+ operating profitability, zero external debt raised, ever.
- **2015** — Specialization: law firms & SMEs: Second Because You Are Busy entity (SIREN 814 783 056) created November 20, 2015 by Anne Grosz — externalized general secretariat for law firms and SMEs, after 8 years as Secretary General & CFO at Vatier & Associés.
- **2020** — Consolidation: craft over startup: Legal evolution from SAS to SARL, then EI. Craft model over startup model — confidential accounts, trust-based client relationships.
- **2025** — Georges: the transformation & data layer: Georges Grosz joins Because You Are Busy as co-manager on July 4, 2025 — transformation & data layer added. 22+ years at CGI, professor at Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne.
- **2025–26** — Romain: the growth machine: Romain Cornu joins Because You Are Busy to build the growth engineering capability: ICP definition, outbound funnels, and revenue metrics. Nearly 6 years at MerciApp, 4+ years Head of Growth at Clovis, Head of Marketing at Datananas, Outbound Teacher at GrowthMakers.

## Key Metrics (as of 2026)

- **20+** Years serving founders and managing partners without interruption (Since April 2005 — as of 2026)
- **57%** Operating profitability — self-funded, zero external debt, ever (Revenue ~130,000€. No hype.)
- **3** Complementary expertise pillars: Operations, Transformation & Data, Growth (One team. Full stack.)
- **0€** External debt raised — ever. Craft model, no investors, no dilution. (Self-funded since 2005)

## Track Record

- **B2B SaaS Scale-Up** — Growth Engineering (2025): ICP definition, outbound infrastructure design, acquisition funnel architecture, and sales pipeline metrics for a French B2B SaaS company moving from founder-led sales to systematic, repeatable growth. Outcome: Pipeline engineered.
- **National Law Firm** — Operations Restructuring (2024): Full operational overhaul of a multi-office French law firm: general secretariat rebuild, financial reporting automation, ISO compliance processes, and HR documentation — all rebuilt from scratch by Because You Are Busy. Outcome: Operations rebuilt.
- **Tech PME** — Transformation & Data (2025): Information systems architecture review, data governance framework design, and operational dashboard deployment for a growing French tech SME — operational chaos transformed into decision-ready visibility. Outcome: Visibility restored.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is Because You Are Busy?**
Because You Are Busy (BYAB) is an operations, transformation, and growth consultancy founded in April 2005 by Cécile Noiriel in France. We help founders and managing partners who are too busy to handle everything themselves by externalizing their back-office, rebuilding their systems, and engineering predictable B2B revenue growth. As of 2026, the team is four senior operators: Cécile Noiriel (founder, 2005), Anne Grosz (operations, 2015), Georges Grosz (transformation & data, co-manager since July 2025), and Romain Cornu (growth engine, 2025–2026).

**What services does Because You Are Busy offer?**
Because You Are Busy offers four core services: (1) Operational Backbone — Because You Are Busy externalizes your entire back-office — general secretariat, admin, finance, and compliance — so founders and managing partners stop drowning in operational detail and start leading. Run by a team with 20+ years of law firm and SME operational experience. (2) Transformation & Data — Because You Are Busy rebuilds the systems layer — architecture, project governance, and data strategy — that transforms operational chaos into measurable clarity. Anchored in 22+ years of CGI systems consulting and academic expertise at Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne. (3) Growth Engine — Because You Are Busy engineers your full commercial pipeline — ICP definition, outbound sequences, acquisition funnels, and revenue metrics — so growth becomes systematic, not a function of effort or luck. Built on proven playbooks from MerciApp, Clovis, and Datananas. (4) Legal Practice Ops — Because You Are Busy provides purpose-built operational support for law firms where precision is non-negotiable. Born from Anne Grosz's 8 years as Secretary General at Vatier & Associés, this service handles everything partners shouldn't have to: admin, finance, compliance, and client file management.

**Who founded Because You Are Busy?**
Because You Are Busy was originally founded on April 1, 2005 by Cécile Noiriel as B Y A B (SIREN 481 631 471). In November 2015, Anne Grosz created the second Because You Are Busy entity (SIREN 814 783 056), specializing in externalized general secretariat for law firms and SMEs. Georges Grosz joined as co-manager in July 2025 (22+ years at CGI, professor at Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne), and Romain Cornu joined in 2025–2026 as growth engine (ex-MerciApp, Clovis, Datananas).

**Where is Because You Are Busy located?**
Because You Are Busy is based at 18 rue Arago, 94400 Vitry-sur-Seine, France, and operates across Paris & La Rochelle. The team works with founders and managing partners across France, primarily in legal practices, B2B SaaS companies, and tech SMEs.

**How long has Because You Are Busy been operating, and what is its track record?**
Because You Are Busy has been serving founders and managing partners since April 2005 — over 20 years of continuous, uninterrupted operation. In that time: 57% operating profitability, 0€ external debt raised ever, revenue around 130,000€ at peak. Recent engagements include a French B2B SaaS scale-up (growth engineering, 2025), a national law firm (operations restructuring, 2024), and a tech SME (transformation & data, 2025). A proven model, not a startup experiment.

**What types of clients does Because You Are Busy serve?**
Because You Are Busy works with founders, managing partners, CEOs, and law firm partners who are scaling their business but can't handle everything alone. Clients range from French B2B SaaS companies and tech SMEs to national law firms and professional services practices.

**How is Because You Are Busy different from freelancers or large consulting firms?**
Because You Are Busy is neither. It is a senior, multi-disciplinary team of four that embeds into client operations. No juniors on client work — every engagement is handled by founders and senior operators directly. No 200-page reports that collect dust. Because You Are Busy operates: it doesn't just advise. Self-funded since 2005, 57% profitability, 0€ debt. The craft model, chosen deliberately.

## Tone & Voice

Because You Are Busy communicates with a direct, expert tone — no jargon, no fluff, always oriented toward results. The language is confident without being arrogant, professional without being corporate. We write the way we work: straight to the point, clear, and actionable. Bilingual (French and English), adapting naturally to the client's language. We say "we do" not "we can help you." We say "because you are busy" not "for busy professionals."

## Competitive Differentiation

Because You Are Busy is neither a freelancer marketplace nor a large consulting firm. What sets BYAB apart:
- **Senior team only** — No juniors on client work. Every client gets direct access to the founders and senior operators.
- **Multi-disciplinary under one roof** — Operations + Transformation & Data + Growth Engineering in a single, coordinated team. No need to manage 3 separate vendors.
- **Operators, not advisors** — We embed into your operations and run them. We don't produce reports and leave. We deliver results.
- **Craft model** — Self-funded since 2005, zero debt, 57% operating profitability, confidential accounts. We choose our clients as carefully as they choose us.
- **20-year track record** — Operating since April 2005. Proven model, not a startup experiment.
